newsitem.title: USA: Marcus expects to boost capital spending.
newsitem.headline: Marcus expects to boost capital spending.

text.p: Marcus Corp said Thursday it expected to boost capital spending in fiscal year 1998.

"With our strong cash flow and relatively low debt, we are in a good position to carry out our growth strategy and capitalize on new opportunities. Subject to changes in the economy and market conditions, we plan to further increase our capital expenditures in fiscal 1998," Stephen Marcus, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
Earlier Marcus said it earned $8.8 million, or $0.44 a share, in the fourth quarter ended May 29 versus $7.8 million, or $0.39, in the same period last year.
Capital expenditures rose 28.5 percent during fiscal year 1997 to $107.5 million, as the company continued to invest in new motel, theatre and hotel properties, Marcus said.
